profile.name: Milcah Mwangi
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer — Fintech Systems & AI Model Evaluation
profile.tagline: 20 years building mission-critical backend systems for UK banks and fintechs, plus 4+ years of contract AI model evaluation
profile.availability: Open to senior backend and AI evaluation roles — fully remote across UK, US, and APAC time zones
profile.bio: Software engineer with 20 years building mission-critical backend systems for UK banks and fintechs (OakNorth, Close Brothers, Paragon Banking Group, Secure Trust Bank), progressing from IC to Principal Engineer leading teams of up to 12, then moving into independent consulting and 4+ years of contract AI model evaluation work. Delivered lending platforms processing £150M+ in monthly commercial volume at sub-120ms p99 latency, and scored 1,200+ model outputs at a 95%+ QA acceptance rate across Outlier, Telus, Alignerr, Scale AI, and Appen. Native-level English (C2). Fully remote, self-directed delivery across UK, US, and APAC time zones.

achievements: Architected and shipped production FastAPI microservices powering NLP and AI evaluation workflows for enterprise clients, sustaining high uptime across PostgreSQL-on-AWS backends
